data.body:
Final rebar-debug report

Problem: the session-scoped AST provenance guard was an individual >30s setup long pole in every Ubuntu Verify cell (49.96s/53.03s/53.58s in run 31778457611).

Proven root cause: `_enclosing` rebuilt a full parent map per lookup and `_verdict` re-walked every cached source tree for every parameter hop (pre-fix tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py:377 and :464-479). Parsing was cached; parent/caller relationships were not.

Proof: instrumented cold process observed 9,610,138 AST node iterations and ~130.9M calls while returning the same ordered 24 tuples. The held-out oracle first RED with all semantic tuples matching but all 486 modules over the whole-tree budget (maximum 30 walks), ruling out I/O/assertions and isolating rediscovery.

Test: `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py::test_provenance_scan_preserves_verdicts_with_linear_whole_tree_work`. Final-form oracle freezes the exact 24 ordered tuples, proves the real >=400-module corpus ran, and enforces <=3 whole-module walks (function discovery, site discovery, shared index). It was RED before the fix, held outside the fixer worktree, GREEN afterward, and returned to RED when per-lookup parent-map rebuilding was defect-seeded (12 modules over budget, maximum 13), then GREEN again after restoration. Refactoring litmus: it observes semantic tuples and traversal budget, not local variable names/source text.

Fix: one immutable process-local `_AstIndex` now indexes parents, functions, and call sites once from the already-cached 486 parsed modules. `_functions`, `_enclosing`, `_verdict`, and `_run_request_sites` query it. Exact tuple SHA-256 remained `6fc9e2cf…67a1`; cold scan improved 3.260600s -> 0.808266s (~4x), AST iterations 9,610,138 -> 569,517, and cached repeat is 0.005211s with zero further module walks.

Scope/safety: private test-only helpers and callers; no production/public API behavior, dependency, test skip/xfail, assertion removal, or coverage reduction. 13 focused tests, lint, mypy, config-check, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 passed. The broad local suite was stopped at 7% because it projected ~1h and would only duplicate the full Gerrit gate; Gerrit executed the complete suite successfully.

Siblings: bounded construct sweep of this provenance module found one remaining `ast.walk(fn)` over already-selected enclosing function subtrees, not repeated whole-corpus rediscovery; accepted because it is local to assignment lookup and did not appear in the >30s profile. The only whole-module traversal is now the one-time index builder. Parity sweep N/A: this is a test helper with no CLI/MCP/library/automation parallel surface.

Residual risk: macOS remains the wall-clock critical path, not this Ubuntu setup. Run 31786710110 passed in 1,921s (32m01s): macOS job 1,850s; default 1,599s; integration 144s. Ubuntu jobs were 713s/782s/800s with default 576s/634s/648s and integration 82s/91s/90s. Disposition: continue under parent investigation `inedible-subsimious-brahmancow` and the approved Pandoc/process tickets; do not weaken coverage. The two LLM-Review advisories about redundant literal precondition assertions are accepted as non-behavioral: exact computed `sites == _EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES` is the operative oracle, and an extra patchset would spend a full Verify run for no fidelity/runtime benefit.

Replication: original real-corpus scenario no longer reproduces the repeated rediscovery; scan is ~4x faster locally with identical outputs. Gerrit change 1770 merged after both required votes and zero unresolved comments.
